items.item_text: Bachelor’s Degree in related area
1 or more years of direct Lead and/or Supervisory experience to select, train, motivate, recognize, supervise, evaluate the performance of staff and ensure operational success.
2 or more years of customer service experience in retail, restaurant, hotel, health care, or similar customer facing environment.
Experience creating training materials and or providing direct policy or process training.
Working knowledge of the organization and ability to resolve complex patient and guest experience issues.

This position serves as a non-clinical resource and liaison for patients and their families. Provides support, guidance and assistance for patients and families as they navigate through complex healthcare environments. Primary goals are to increase patient and guest satisfaction, provide identification badges at most patient and guest entry points, and to optimize care and outcomes. Acts as a communication liaison to understand patients’ and guests’ needs, desires, and concerns. Provides guidance about a broad range of services, amenities, and information to promote healing and ensure satisfaction with the patient and guest experience.
30% - Guest Relations Lead/Team Trainer

In addition to the Patient Navigator 2 Non-Clinical (Guest Relations Associate) job functions, this role acts as the Lead and primary team trainer for all new and existing staff. The position will work closely with the Guest Relations Supervisors to develop training materials for the various areas that the department supports and will provide individual and group training sessions on new and existing processes and policies. This position will act as the first point of contact for escalated situations when the Supervisors or Manager are unavailable, and they will be responsible for providing recommendations and service recovery, as appropriate. Although this position will not be directly responsible for the performance management of the Guest Relations Associates, they will be responsible for providing feedback to supervisors on performance of staff, as appropriate.
65% - Patient Support Services
Must maintain a clean and well-groomed professional appearance and adhere to department uniform guidelines.
Proficiency with health-related computer systems.
Proficiency with PassagePoint or other visitor management systems.

Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to clearly and effectively interact with a diverse group of individuals to secure and/or provide information to clarify situations and resolve problems.
Working knowledge of UC Davis Visitor policies and processes.
Demonstrated skills to build effective working relationships and work collaboratively.
Ability to make quick and sound decisions based on individual situations to meet patient and guest needs.
Ability to perform job tasks quickly, efficiently, accurately and with composure while under pressure; manage heavy or emergent workloads, with interruptions and potentially volatile situations.
Working knowledge of Patient Rights & Responsibilities, Joint Commission standards, and Centers for Medicare / Medicaid regulations.
Knowledge of data collection, compilation, and analytical techniques.
Skills to comprehend and assess patient and guest complains to quickly locate appropriate resources for assistance.
Proficiency with Windows-based software including Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.
